data.name: Arbon
data.description: Arbon is a Brooklyn-based climate tech startup spun out of Columbia University developing humidity-swing (moisture-swing) sorbent technology for direct air capture and point-source CO2 capture. The company holds a Frontier Climate 2023 offtake contract and was selected into the Carbon-to-Value 2025 fifth cohort and Activate Fellows program. It operates from Newlab in Brooklyn with a small team scaling from gram- to ton-scale pilots.
